purpose: Versioned historical operating evidence monitor with explicit economic-period and snapshot freshness
expected_period: latest calendar quarter-end <= snapshot; conservative research freshness convention, not statutory disclosure deadline
selection: only exact expected economic period in same R73 snapshot can supply current evidence; absent period=period_not_in_source; insufficient coverage stays unknown; never fall back to previous good quarter
last_observation: retain latest coverage-passing economic period separately as historical context, not current or stage probability
scope: nonfinancial accounting only; financial or unknown identity remains inapplicable/unknown
integration: R63 base unchanged; attach most recent R73 snapshot <= base asof; older snapshot may only populate last-observation metadata, all current ratios null
ratios: capex_up/joint_known, both_improve/capex_up, both_decline/capex_up; zero denominator unknown
limits: quarter-end policy deliberately exposes reporting lag; no live collection, ranks, probability, deployment or forecast
